title: The Lokpal

endcard.line: Pictures: David Castor (public domain); Ankur Panchbudhe from Pune, India (CC BY 2.0)

segments.say: Eight Lokpal bills had been brought to the Lok Sabha before, and none became law. The one introduced in twenty eleven finally passed in December twenty thirteen.
The law set up a Lokpal at the Centre, and asked the States to set up Lokayuktas by their own laws within a year.

anim.title: Who sits on the Lokpal
items: At least half from SC, ST, OBC, minorities and women

segments.say: It has a Chairperson and up to eight Members. Half must be judicial Members, and at least half must come from Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, minorities and women.
A Search Committee helps a Selection Committee, which recommends the names. The President then appoints them.

anim.title: The Selection Committee
items: Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha
Chief Justice of India, or a judge nominated

segments.say: That committee has the Prime Minister, the Speaker, the Leader of Opposition, the Chief Justice of India or a nominated judge, and an eminent jurist.
Its reach covers central public servants from Group A to Group D, and even the Prime Minister, with exclusions and a special process.
The first appointments came in March twenty nineteen. For GS Two, remember the five-member Selection Committee and the two fifty per cent rules.

sources: PIB, The Lokpal and Lokayuktas Bill backgrounder, 23 December 2013 (relid 102096): passed by Rajya Sabha on 17 December and Lok Sabha on 18 December 2013; eight Lokpal Bills had been introduced in the Lok Sabha in the past; all past attempts failed; Lokpal Bill 2011 introduced on 4 August 2011

PIB, Year End Review 2013, DoPT (relid 102175): Lokpal at the Centre and Lokayuktas in States by State law within one year; a Chairperson and a maximum of eight Members, fifty per cent judicial; fifty per cent from SC, ST, OBCs, minorities and women; Selection Committee of the PM, Speaker, Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha, CJI or a sitting SC judge nominated by the CJI, and an eminent jurist nominated by the President; Search Committee to assist; PM under the Lokpal with subject-matter exclusions and a specific process; jurisdiction over Group A, B, C and D

PIB, Appointment of Members of Lokpal, 4 July 2019 (PRID 1577175): the President appointed the Chairperson and eight Members (including four judicial Members) on 19 March 2019 on the Selection Committee's recommendation

quiz.q: At most, how many Members can the Lokpal have besides the Chairperson?
quiz.why: A Chairperson and a maximum of eight Members.

quiz.q: Which of these is NOT on the Lokpal Selection Committee?
options: The Speaker of the Lok Sabha
quiz.why: The committee is the PM, Speaker, Leader of Opposition, CJI or nominee, and an eminent jurist.
